network.title: Local command and MCP proxy
network.scope: Applies to local commands, MCP installation, MCP processes, HTTP MCP and OAuth requests. Model APIs, cloud sync and updates are not affected.
network.urlHint: HTTP or HTTPS proxy without authentication. This setting overrides proxy variables in MCP configuration.
network.bypassHint: One hostname, domain or host:port per line. Loopback addresses always bypass the proxy.
network.limit: Applications that implement their own networking may ignore proxy environment variables. Settings apply to new tasks and connections.

configChanged: The source configuration changed. Refresh before continuing.
modeHint: Termous manages supported single-package npx commands. Other commands use your external environment.
